Relax and unwind fully with our Reflection Full Spa Day, treat yourself to the lavish escape you deserve  – a day designed to rejuvenate your mind, body, and soul. From 9 am to 5:15 pm, immerse yourself in the spa world, taking advantage of our facilities, including:
Pool, Jacuzzi, Sauna, Steam Room, and state-of-the-art Gym.

As you embark on this sensory journey, relish in the blissful ambiance of our spa while cocooned in a plush robe and comfortable slippers, provided along with a soft towel for your convenience.
Elevate your spa day with a High Tea, offering a delightful selection of treats to tantalize your taste buds and complement your pampering experience.

The highlight of your day awaits with two hours of indulgent treatments. Choose from our curated selection of premium therapies, including a Full Body Massage, a rejuvenating Germaine De Cappucini Facial, Gel Luxury Manicure and Gel Luxury Pedicure. Please choose 2.

This spa day package includes:
Use of the Pool, Jacuzzi, Sauna, Steam Room and Gym
9am-5:15pm
High Tea
Towel, robe and slippers
Two hours of Treatment.

ALL spa day guests MUST BE 16 years old and over.
